newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Wallis inquiry paper due Thursday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Wallis inquiry paper due Thursday.

text.p: The Australian government said on Wednesday it would release a discussion paper on its financial industry inquiry on Thursday.
The inquiry, headed by businessman Stan Wallis, is looking at financial sector issues including foreign ownership restrictions, shareholding limits and prudential regulation.

It is also considering whether mergers should be allowed between Australia's four major banks -- the National Australia Bank Ltd, Westpac Banking Corp, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and the Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd.
The inquiry is due to conclude in March next year.
